A gives a useful ready-made pitch for the PM and names a concrete starting set of three, but it runs longer. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers agree with the user and build around a command palette, shortcut labels on menu items and buttons, and one-time hints after a repeated mouse action. Both also cover rebinding and measuring real adoption instead of tour completion. B edges ahead because it commits to a starting set of two or three shortcuts chosen by type of legal work and includes a ready 'For the PM' pitch, but it runs longer than A and offers a short optional tour as a fallback.
